title: Capstone: The Lesson That Went Sideways

noah_g5_fractions.win_line: Ohhh. Wait. I had it backwards!

deshawn_offtask.opening_line: (leans back and starts joking with the side table) This is taking forever.

marcus_volatile.target_label: Calm him first: revoice, then wait
marcus_volatile.opening_line: (pushes the paper away) I already said I don't get it. I'm done.

priya_quiet.opening_line: (has a good idea written down, but keeps her hand low while the loud kids talk)

story_hook: The projector's dead, a chair's on the floor, and four kids need you at once. Pick who goes first.
